name: c4-diagrams
description: C4 architecture diagrams - System Context, Container, Component, Code, plus Dynamic and Deployment views (Simon Brown's C4 model). Use whenever the user wants to draw, update, or review an architecture diagram, model or visualise a system's structure, reverse-engineer C4 from an existing codebase or repo, write or edit a Structurizr DSL workspace (workspace.dsl), or produce a Mermaid / PlantUML / D2 architecture diagram - even when they don't say "C4" (e.g. "diagram how this service fits together", "draw the containers for this repo").
